exclusion_detail: The featured compound TDI-11861 (33) is made in Scheme 5 in about 10 reactions from ethyl 4-iodo-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxylate (THP protection, Grignard/aldehyde addition, TMSCl/NaI deoxygenation, N-difluoromethylation, Claisen-type keto-ester formation, guanidine condensation, POCl3, dihydroxylation, periodate cleavage, reductive amination; the SI also shows a THP removal), far above the 4-reaction limit.

lead.label: 33 (TDI-11861)
lead.why: The abstract says the campaign identified sAC inhibitors with high potency, fast on and slow off rates; the paper's conclusions name TDI-11861 (33) as the optimised compound (Kd 3.3 nM vs 160 nM for TDI-10229, tested in vivo in mice).

notes: Schemes 1-5 of the main text and the SI experimental were read for 2, 4, 19, 20 and 33; all need 6 or more reactions. The SI analogues 5-14, 16-18 and 21-32 were not read individually; they share the same pyrazole ester, keto ester, aminochloropyrimidine sequence, so I expect none to be 4 steps or fewer, but I did not verify each.
